title: S4: Python symbols and scopes (ADR 0008)
description: ADR 0008 / DEC-303 (a2) rulings 2, 7: definitions, classes, methods, nested defs, qualified names, scopes, decorators, properties, overload groups, branch-conditional definitions. Emits SymbolEntry-shaped symbols plus the additive optional qualname (DEC-303 (a5) Q6 arm A: the full enclosing dotted name without the PEP 3155 <locals> segment); container keeps its documented meaning (nearest enclosing class). Built on the S2b parse wrapper; not wired to the CLI.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Rules per case written before the code and every case has a test
Every symbol of the click 7.1.2 and requests ground-truth targets exists at the keyed def/class line with the right qualname (scorer mapping, no exit 6)
qualname carries the full enclosing dotted name without a <locals> segment, e.g. Parameter.type_cast_value._convert; container is the nearest enclosing class only
Symbols in branches unreachable under Python 3 are still emitted (reachability is call attribution, not the symbol table)

implementationNotes: S4 BRIEF (approved by the leader; draft rule list the specialist refines in its first EMPTY commit): 1 identity (R, Addendum 2 rule 5): line = def/class keyword line, never a decorator line; startLine includes decorators and leading comments; id = file:line:column of the name as TypeScript; 2 qualname (R, Q6 arm A, DEC-303 (a5) commit 5b0781e4): emit an additive OPTIONAL qualname on symbols = the FULL enclosing qualified name (e.g. Parameter.type_cast_value._convert), absent for TypeScript; container keeps its documented meaning (nearest enclosing class); the gate scorer reads qualname and a target symbol without it is exit 6; 3 kinds (D): module-level def function, def in a class body method, property/.setter property, class class; staticmethod/classmethod are method; nested defs in functions are function; no new SymbolKind; 4 overload groups (R, Addendum 6 item 1): an @overload group collapses to its implementation: ONE symbol at the implementation line, stubs not emitted but counted in coverage; a group with no implementation keeps the last stub and notes it; the scorer maps stub-keyed ground-truth targets through test/python-gate/requests-3c7baaa/overload-groups.json; 5 branch-conditional definitions (R, (a3) Q2 plus the scorer exit-6 rule): every definition is emitted regardless of branch INCLUDING the if PY2 arm (symbols are not attribution; S5 owns reachability); two definitions with the same qualified name are both emitted at their own lines (e.g. click _compat.py get_text_stdin at 248 and 446); 6 decorators (D): each application is data for a later decorator site kind (S7 declares); a decorated name that returns another object is flagged not dropped (click @command); 7 class scope (D): class-body names are members; nested classes get the full path; global/nonlocal recorded as hints for S5; 8 lambdas and comprehensions (D): no symbol, scopes for S5; 9 module variables/assignments/__all__ (D): no symbol in S4; 10 exported (D): module-level def/class not starting with underscore, or listed in a literal __all__ when present; members of an exported class true; 11 async def same as def; 12 ERROR/MISSING (S2b inherit): a definition inside an ERROR region is dropped and the file named. ACCEPTANCE EVIDENCE: every ground-truth target of click (test/python-gate/click-7.1.2/targets.json, 45 targets) and requests (requests-3c7baaa/targets.json, 46) resolves through the scorer mapping (file + def line + qualname) without exit 6, using scratch checkouts of the pinned sources (not vendored; click 7.1.2 at 1784558e, requests at 3c7baaa; downloads from codeload into EMPTY scratch dirs, untrusted), the three overload stub targets mapped to their implementation lines. The branch needs the S0/S0b data: merge test/GCLI-74-requests-independent (data only; a conflict in a ground-truth/scorer/data file is a HARD STOP, docs conflicts are the workers). Dispatch only after the S2b delta review is clean (stack on feat/GCLI-73-python-parser 1eab226). No CLI wiring, no cache, no new dependency.

SUPERSEDING (2026-11-23, Opus S6 review): any earlier wording that container carries the whole enclosing qualified name is superseded by (a5) Q6 arm A. qualname = full enclosing dotted name WITHOUT the PEP 3155 <locals> segment (nested targets: Parameter.type_cast_value._convert, wrap_text._flush_par, should_bypass_proxies.get_proxy, _init.doc; an indexer emitting __qualname__ would exit 6 on them); container = nearest enclosing class.

S4 landed at 79fc3a2 (stacked on S2b 206324d plus the --no-ff merge of test/GCLI-74-requests-independent; push order S0/S0b before S3/S4). Verified by the worker under pinned bun 1.4.2: bun run check 322 pass 0 fail (289 before), lore 0.14.1 check 0/0; package.json and bun.lock untouched. Checker test/python-gate/check_symbol_targets.ts against pinned sources: click 133/133 targets (batch 0 45/45; targets.json holds 133 over batches 0-2, the brief's 45 is the scored batch 0), requests 46/46, 3 overload targets mapped to implementation lines; hard-fails on count mismatch, miss, duplicate signature, zero read. Mutations red: qualname->bare name, startLine->def line, collapseOverloadGroups disabled. STATED LIMITS for S7/S8: (1) the id column is tree-sitter's UTF-8 byte offset, TypeScript's is UTF-16: equal for ASCII, a named limit, no ground-truth target affected; (2) the checker is a TypeScript REPRODUCTION of the scorer's target mapping (gate_score.py _match_target_symbols/_target_symbol_line), not a run of gate_score.py: S4 has no call sites; the real end-to-end gate run is S8; (3) cached_property is a method (only property/.setter/.getter/.deleter are kind property); (4) rule 7 (class-body names are members) vs rule 9 (assignments are not symbols): class-body assignments emit no symbol; (5) a nameless def parses as ERROR in this grammar so rule 12's skipped-and-counted branch is unreachable through the public parser; (6) overload grouping is by qualname within one file, a group split across branches is not distinguished (no ground-truth case); (7) a group with several non-@overload definitions keeps all implementations; (8) decorator-replaces-object is not decidable statically: every decorated symbol is flagged, none dropped, S7 decides; (9) __all__: non-literal or += falls back to the underscore rule, a literal inside an if is not read. Rules R (ruled): def/class keyword line, qualname full dotted path without <locals> plus container nearest class, overload collapse, branch-conditional emission; all others D (proposals), listed in commit 73e5e4e.
